exposure: trial of labor with one prior cesarean delivery
cohort: Women undergoing a trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC)
finding: Women with pregestational diabetes undergoing TOLAC had a higher rate of uterine rupture than women without pregestational diabetes.
mod_finding: Women undergoing a trial of labor who have pregestational diabetes had a higher rate of uterine rupture than women without a history of pregestational diabetes.
